# HMN24

> > HMN24 is a circadian modulation nutrition brand offering time-optimized supplements and beverages designed to enhance cognitive performance, sleep quality, and athletic output through chronobiology-based formulations.

HMN24 specializes in functional nutrition products aligned with circadian rhythms, including nootropics (Rise, Flow), sleep optimization (Pre-Sleep), and performance supplements (Hydrate). The brand combines circadian science with athlete endorsements and educational content on biohacking and chronobiology.

## Key Topics

- circadian rhythm
- circadian modulation
- nootropics
- performance optimization
- sleep optimization
- Rise (morning nootropic)
- Flow (afternoon nootropic)
- Pre-Sleep (sleep supplement)
- Hydrate (electrolyte formula)
- chronobiology
- jet lag
- afternoon slump
- functional nutrition
- Informed Sport certification
- athlete testimonials

## Products

- [Rise – HMN24](https://hmn24.com/products/rise): Morning nootropic drink for cognitive arousal and energy optimization.
- [Flow – HMN24](https://hmn24.com/products/flow-1): Caffeine-free nootropic for afternoon performance and sustained focus.
- [Pre-Sleep – HMN24](https://hmn24.com/products/pre-sleep): Magnesium-zinc sleep optimization supplement for restorative rest.
- [Hydrate – HMN24](https://hmn24.com/products/hydrate): Performance electrolyte formula designed for athletic endurance and recovery.
- [HMN24 Travel Pack](https://hmn24.com/products/travel-pack): Bundled supplement collection for jet lag management and on-the-go performance.

## Education & Science

- [Journal – HMN24](https://hmn24.com/blogs/articles): Health and wellness journal covering biohacking, chronobiology, and circadian science.
- [The Afternoon Slump and Energy Timing – HMN24](https://hmn24.com/blogs/articles/the-afternoon-slump-and-energy-timing): Exploration of circadian dips, sleep pressure cycles, and afternoon energy crashes.
- [Towards Credible Bio-Aligned Lighting – HMN24](https://hmn24.com/blogs/articles/towards-credible-bio-aligned-lighting): Analysis of light exposure optimization for circadian rhythm synchronization and performance.
- [The Science Your Meeting Room Is Getting Wrong – HMN24](https://hmn24.com/blogs/articles/the-science-your-meeting-room-is-getting-wrong): Investigation into meeting room air quality impacts on cognitive performance and focus.
- [Gym Equipment Manufacturers, Gym Spaces, and Why They Need to Adapt – HMN24](https://hmn24.com/blogs/articles/gym-equipment-manufacturers-gym-spaces-and-why-they-need-to-adapt): Discussion of gym industry evolution and outcome-driven fitness systems integration.
